info.name: Oxi Office Previews
info.summary: Thumbnails of Word, PowerPoint and Excel files, drawn on your server without LibreOffice
info.description:
Nextcloud ships its Office previews switched off: they start LibreOffice once for every file. This app shows thumbnails of Word, PowerPoint and Excel files in Files without LibreOffice, Collabora or ONLYOFFICE:
- Word (`.docx`, `.docm`, `.dotx`, `.dotm`): the first page. - PowerPoint (`.pptx`, `.pptm`, `.potx`, `.ppsx` and their macro forms): the first slide. - Excel (`.xlsx`, `.xlsm`, `.xltx`, `.xltm`): the first printed page, cut to the part with content.
The thumbnails are drawn by the bundled [Oxi](https://github.com/Ryujiyasu/oxi) engine, a single Rust program that runs on the server itself. The file never leaves your server, and the app makes no network requests.
- Nothing to configure: enable the app and Office files get thumbnails. - Bundled for Linux x86_64 and arm64 (static, so Alpine-based installs work too). - About 0.1 s for a typical file.
Oxi lays documents out to match Microsoft Office, and on files scored against Word's and PowerPoint's own PDFs it is closer than LibreOffice. A thumbnail shows what Oxi's PDF output would.
This app was written with AI assistance (Claude). It is not part of Nextcloud: report problems at the Oxi repository.
